stories.title: Apple macOS Screen Sharing Flaw Exploited on Internet-Exposed Macs to Install Monero Miner
stories.summary: A recently patched security flaw in Apple macOS has come under active exploitation in the wild to deploy a cryptocurrency miner, the Netherlands National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) has warned.
stories.why_it_matters: Defenders should treat this as an immediate exposure-management priority, confirm whether affected systems are internet-facing, review available indicators, and apply verified vendor mitigations or updates.
